goal: causal comparison verdict and final self-contained Stage15 bundle
non_reopen_rule: Stage15-6 is CLOSED. Stage15-7 may summarize, compare, audit provenance, or identify an external future gate, but must not open a new Stage15-6 internal mathematical route.

command_semantics.Stage15-7-main-batch: Continuing Stage15-7 synthesis/finalization chat. Inspect the latest Stage15-7 exit, immediate canonical dependencies, latest audit, and current final-bundle candidate. Advance 3 substantive work units, maximum 5, or stop earlier on a material theorem-species/provenance/measure change. Create a Draft PR for substantive repository changes. The main operator cannot approve its own PR.
command_semantics.Stage15-7-audit: Fresh read-only ChatGPT audit of the latest Stage15-7 Draft PR and its immediate canonical dependencies. Do not modify files. Return the exact audit footer required by audit_contract.

work_unit_priority: reconcile the quantitative Stage15-5 theorem with the independent causal Stage15-6 theorem without conflating theorem species
freeze exact populations, cutoff, normal forms, direction/canonical conventions, and the Stage14-to-Stage15 provenance chain
build the final causal comparison verdict and claims matrix
build or harden the self-contained Stage15 final bundle, manifest, and hostile-review target
close only after a fresh audit finds no load-bearing mathematical, measure, quantifier, provenance, or self-containment gap
required_before_stop: no double charge and cross-promotion audit
material_change_triggers: a claimed final theorem becomes stronger or weaker
the physical population or cutoff changes
a Stage14 or Stage15 theorem is promoted across a different measure
the relation between Stage15-5 quantitative thinning and Stage15-6 causal thinning changes
a new load-bearing dependency is introduced into the final bundle

must_distinguish.quantitative_comparison: Stage15-5 proves the stronger fixed-power survival comparison using the certified Stage14 numerator input; do not present that fixed power as internally rederived by Stage15-6.
must_distinguish.causal_comparison: Stage15-6 independently proves N_2(B)/M_2(B)->0 from the fixed-prime local squareclass sieve on the same physical measure.
must_distinguish.internal_quantitative_boundary: Stage15-6 proved neither an internal fixed delta>0 nor sigma>0.
must_distinguish.future_external_gates: Effective growing-modulus adelic/local sieving or other stronger global mechanisms remain external future possibilities, not unfinished Stage15-6 work.

forbidden_conflations: do not attribute the Stage15-5 B^{-1/2+epsilon} numerator loss to the Stage15-6 local parity tensor
do not use Stage15-6 qualitative zero density as a replacement proof for the Stage15-5 quantitative rate
do not infer perfect-cuboid nonexistence from density decay
do not infer a quantitative rate from finite census evidence
do not turn an external future gate into an open Stage15-6 route

required_sections: survivor normal form and squareclass condition
comparison of quantitative versus causal mechanisms
known notes and external future gates
final_bundle_contract.self_containment_rule: Every load-bearing symbol, population, theorem dependency, cutoff, projection multiplicity, local density, and external theorem interface used in the final verdict must either be stated in the bundle or referenced through an explicit provenance manifest entry.
final_bundle_contract.review_target: A fresh hostile reviewer should be able to audit the final mathematical implication chain without reading the chronological Stage15 task history.

required_checks: physical population, canonical projection, and R<=B cutoff
finite evidence versus asymptotic theorem separation

verdict_semantics.PASS: No load-bearing Stage15-7 gap found. The current PR may merge if aggregate verification also passes.
verdict_semantics.FIX_REQUIRED: A repair is needed in the same Stage15-7 main line. The next Stage15-7-main-batch consumes the exact audit finding; no third normal repair command is introduced.
verdict_semantics.BLOCKED: A missing dependency or external theorem prevents a justified final verdict/bundle. State the exact blocker and do not close Stage15-7.

audit_contract.internal_route_remains_semantics: For Stage15-7, INTERNAL_ROUTE_REMAINS means a distinct unresolved Stage15-7 substantive synthesis/proof-accounting route or load-bearing finalization gap remains. It does not authorize reopening CLOSED Stage15-6.

close_only_if: the final causal comparison verdict is explicit and theorem-species-safe
Stage15-5 and Stage15-6 conclusions are reconciled without circularity or conflation
the final bundle is self-contained at the declared provenance level
all known load-bearing notes are either repaired or explicitly classified as non-load-bearing
no unresolved internal Stage15-7 finalization gap remains
closure_contract.after_close: Do not create a new Stage15-7 mathematical substage unless a later audit proves the closed final verdict itself materially incorrect. Ordinary future strengthening belongs to a later program.

codex_transfer_triggers: aggregate verifier or CI failure requiring repository diagnosis
repo-wide mechanical consistency or generator/controller implementation
source volume cannot be inspected reliably in one ChatGPT audit
same mathematical verdict reverses in two consecutive fresh audits
reproduction requires local execution beyond connector capabilities
codex_non_triggers: a difficult synthesis question by itself
a new external theorem gate by itself
ordinary PR creation through the GitHub connector
hostile mathematical review that fits within one fresh ChatGPT audit
split_triggers: two genuinely independent load-bearing finalization gaps with distinct dependencies
quantitative and causal theorem species require incompatible measure/provenance repairs
a bundle self-containment repair and a mathematical theorem repair become independently blocking
an upstream normal-form change invalidates multiple final-verdict sections
merge_rule: MERGE_ALLOWED only when aggregate verification passes and a fresh Stage15-7-audit returns PASS. Main-batch cannot approve its own PR.
